info.title: Campaigns API
info.description:
Campaigns API lets you send one message to multiple recipients. A segment can contain up to 500 people by default. To increase the limit to 10,000, contact us at [hello@1msg.io](mailto:hello@1msg.io). Inbox methods are not covered in this document.

Use the API groups in this order: Segments → Campaigns → Analytics.

## 1. Segments

Create a segment and add members. Each member requires a `name` and at least one of `phone` or `bsuid`.

## 2. Campaigns

Create a draft with a `channelId` the API key can access and a `segmentId` from the previous step.

Set `content.mode` to `text` or `template`:

- Text: provide `content.text`.
- Template: provide `content.templateName` and `content.language` (e.g. `en`).

For templates:

- `content.params` uses the same format as `sendTemplate` and is forwarded to WABA as-is, supporting header images, body variables, buttons, and carousel cards.
- `content.messageSendTtlSeconds` is optional and sets the delivery window in seconds. It belongs alongside `params`, not inside the template components.

Preview the draft before sending.

To schedule a campaign, set `scheduledAt` to a future ISO 8601 timestamp with `Z` or a numeric offset, e.g. `2026-11-01T09:00:00Z`. Omit it or set it to `null` to start sending immediately.

There is no daily message-count setting. Template sends use the channel's tier limit, returned as `dailyLimit`. Session text messages sent within an open 24-hour window do not count toward this limit.

## 3. Analytics

Read analytics after sending to track campaign performance:

- Overall statistics: total messages sent, delivered, read, and replied to.
- Recipient-level statistics: when each message was sent, delivered and read, when the recipient replied, and their replies — including button clicks and free-text messages.
- Button statistics: see who clicked each button and when.
- Error statistics: see which recipients encountered errors and the corresponding error for each phone number.

## 4. Campaigns webhooks

1MSG sends webhook events to your configured HTTPS URL when segments or campaigns are created or updated, and when a campaign's status changes.

Configure webhooks in Settings → Developer → Webhooks.

### Events

- `segment.created` — A segment was created. `action` is `segment_created`.
- `segment.updated` — A segment or its members changed. `action` can be `segment_updated`, `segment_deleted`, `member_added`, `member_updated`, `member_deleted`, or `members_replaced`. The payload does not identify the affected member.
- `campaign.created` — A campaign draft was created. `scheduledAt` contains the scheduled send time or `null`.
- `campaign.updated` — A campaign draft was updated. `scheduledAt` contains the scheduled send time or `null`.
- `campaign.status_changed` — The campaign status changed to `draft`, `sending`, `pause`, `completed`, `failed`, or `scheduled`. `scheduledAt` contains the scheduled send time or `null`.

## Authorization

The key must include the Campaigns scope. Issue it in Settings → Developer → API key.

```
Authorization: Bearer 1msg_live_…
```

bearer.description: Key issued in Settings → Developer → API key. Inbox methods need the Inbox scope. Campaigns methods need the Campaigns scope.

members.description: Non-empty list. Each item needs name and a phone or a BSUID. A duplicate phone or BSUID in the segment is rejected. The segment cannot exceed 500 members.

memberIds.description: Member ids from the member list. Other members stay.

phone.description: E.164 phone, for example +15551234567. After the update the member still needs a phone or a BSUID.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, for example ab.abc123xyz. A trailing @lid is stored without it.

name.description: New name, up to 200 characters. Send only the fields that change.
Campaign title shown in the list.

channelId.description: Id of the channel that sends. The key must be allowed to use this channel.

segmentId.description: Segment id from POST /campaigns/segments. Members are copied when you send.

content.description: template or text. For a template set templateName, language, and params.

status.description: Only draft is accepted. Omit to store draft.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO-8601 instant with a Z or a numeric offset, for example 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z. Omit or null to start now. There is no per-day field. Template sends use the channel tier.
New future ISO-8601 instant with a Z or a numeric offset, for example 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z. Required. Only a campaign that is already scheduled can be moved.

phone.description: E.164 phone, for example +15551234567. Send exactly one of phone or bsuid. Does not change campaign status or analytics.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, for example ab.abc123xyz. A trailing @lid is accepted. Send exactly one of phone or bsuid.

name.description: New title. Send at least one of name, channelId, segmentId, or content. Only a draft can be changed.

segmentId.description: Another segment id. The new members are copied when you send.

content.description: Replaces the whole content object. Same template and text rules as create.

phone.description: E.164 phone, for example +15551234567. Required when bsuid is omitted.

bsuid.description: Provider BSUID, for example ab.abc123xyz. A trailing @lid is accepted and stored without it. Phone or BSUID is required.

mode.description: template sends a WABA template. text sends session text and only reaches people inside the 24-hour window.

templateName.description: WABA template name. Required when mode is template.

language.description: Template language code, for example en or pt_BR. Required when mode is template.

variables.description: Flat body placeholders only, for example { "1": "Ana" }. A numeric key fills the body. Header, buttons, and carousel are not filled here — use params. Ignored when params is set.

params.description: Preferred template fill. The same array sendTemplate accepts. Each item is a component with type (header, body, button, carousel, or a newer WABA type). The array is forwarded as-is, including a header image link. When this is set, variables is ignored. An empty array is valid.

messageSendTtlSeconds.description: How many seconds WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver this template. Same field as sendTemplate messageSendTtlSeconds. It sits beside params, not inside the params array. Omit it to use the template default.

text.description: Session text. Required when mode is text. Not counted against the channel tier.
